liquidity_funding.text: Liquidity rose by {{liquidity.change@FY2024}} to {{liquidity@FY2024}}, of which {{undrawn_facilities@FY2024}} in undrawn committed facilities, and cash and cash-like investments increased by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}.

Debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, but short-term debt cover was stable at {{short_term_debt_cover@FY2024}}, so the near-term maturities are covered by liquidity without new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments rose by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, lifting FCF after leases to debt by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}, the comparable measure of cash left for debt holders once lease payments in financing cash flows are taken out.

Customer prepayments remain large: contract liabilities rose by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, while advance ticket cover fell by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}.

watch_items.text: Unit cost: CASK ex-fuel rose by {{cask_ex_fuel.change@FY2024}} to {{cask_ex_fuel@FY2024}}, so non-fuel costs absorbed part of the revenue gain.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}} is above the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@FY2024}} but the weakest of the group ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@FY2024}}), a sensitivity if bookings slow.

Committed facilities: undrawn committed credit facilities fell by {{undrawn_facilities.change@FY2024}} to {{undrawn_facilities@FY2024}}, so a larger share of liquidity now rests on cash of {{cash_like@FY2024}}.

Maturities: debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, covered {{short_term_debt_cover@FY2024}} by liquidity, so refinancing needs to be met without a fall in the cash buffer.
